d.title: Yi Ren Zhi Xia: Xiu Tie Chong Xian
d.synopsis: Express Delivery Company dispatches Zhang Chulan and Feng Baobao on a special mission to escort the legendary sword Zhiwan to the border, fulfilling a decades-old agreement with Japan's Ishikawa family. They face formidable enemies called Bihe Ninjas seeking to steal the sword.
